title: KEEL landing page — choose the composition
question: World stays: painterly sunset sky, nautical glyphs, Fraunces. This choice is the page's structure. The roll assigned Into the Storm.

options.label: Into the Storm
options.lineage: voyage log — fair weather to gale, one continuous descent
options.thesis: One scrolling descent from calm sky into the storm: the page itself weathers the crash the product survives.
options.viewport: Full sky hero: thesis line, two CTAs (Verify the run / GitHub), and a live proof strip — commit block, 2 receipts, ALL ROUNDS CONSISTENT — floating on the clouds. Normal scroll from there.
options.risk: The dark-descent continuity takes careful section blending or it reads as unrelated dark slabs.

regions.label: crash chart — round by round (sky darkens)

options.label: Three Doors
options.thesis: Hero states the claim; three doors — HIDE, PROVE, SURVIVE — each open into a dense proof section a judge can take in any order.
options.viewport: Sky hero with the one-liner, then three tall doors side by side above the fold: HIDE (jitter band), PROVE (commit→receipt→reveal), SURVIVE (crash chart thumbnail). Each scrolls to its section.
options.risk: Fragments the single argument; judges may open one door and miss the strongest proof.

options.label: The Argument
options.lineage: measured essay with a ledger margin
options.thesis: One narrow editorial column argues leak → jitter → proof in dense prose and inline figures; the margin carries the on-chain artifacts — block numbers, tx hashes, verdicts.
options.viewport: Sky band a third tall with title + one-liner; below, the column begins immediately — 'Your liquidation bot has a number' — with the commit block and verdict pinned in the right margin.
options.risk: Text-forward; a skimming judge must be caught by the margin artifacts or the inline chart.

regions.label: margin ledger — tx hashes, blocks, verdict
